title: Large Language Models Systematically Favor Popular Options: Evidence and Mitigation Across MCQs
abstract: arXiv:2608.29257v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs) are a standard format for evaluating large language models (LLMs), yet the popularity of answer options can confound evaluation. Modern LLMs systematically prefer popular but incorrect options over less popular correct ones, a vulnerability we call \textbf{popularity bias}. This pattern aligns with confidence miscalibration: model confidence remains high even as accuracy collapses for popular options. To systematically isolate this phenomenon, we introduce \textbf{PopMCQ}, a benchmark with six controlled strategies that vary option popularity while keeping the correct answer fixed. In our most adversarial setting, where all distractors are more popular than the correct option, models choose popular but wrong answers 66\% of the time. translated_abstract: 多选题（MCQ）是评估大语言模型（LLM）的标准格式，然而答案选项的流行度可能会干扰评估结果。现代大语言模型系统性地偏好热门但不正确的选项，而非不那么热门的正确选项，我们将这种脆弱性称为**流行度偏差**（popularity bias）。这一模式与置信度校准失误相一致：即使面对热门选项时准确率大幅下降，模型的置信度依然保持高位。为了系统地隔离这一现象，我们提出了 **PopMCQ**，这是一个包含六种受控策略的基准，这些策略在保持正确答案不变的情况下改变选项的流行度。在我们最具对抗性的设置中，即所有干扰项都比正确选项更热门时，模型有66%的概率选择热门但错误的答案。为了缓解这一偏差，我们提出了 **PopDebias**，这是一种轻量级的推理时校正方法，用于估计并从模型预测中去除流行度先验。它仅需……
tldr: 本文揭示了大语言模型在多选题评估中系统性偏好热门选项的“流行度偏差”问题，并提出了PopMCQ基准和轻量级推理时校正方法PopDebias来检测与缓解这一偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a "popularity bias" in LLMs where they systematically favor popular options in MCQ evaluation, and proposes the PopMCQ benchmark along with a lightweight inference-time correction method called PopDebias to detect and mitigate this bias.
